title: Team Workshops
seo: AI workshops for your team, live online
meta: Live hands-on sessions that teach your team practical AI skills on their own work. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Live AI workshops that teach your team practical skills
overview: Slides do not change habits, practice does. We run live online workshops where your team works on their own real tasks, such as writing replies, summarizing notes or building a simple checklist, with us guiding. We prepare examples from your business beforehand, cover safe use, and give everyone a handout and recording to keep. You leave with skills used the next morning.

pkgs.blurb: One live session for a small team, with a handout.
Two sessions, practice tasks and a recording.
Three sessions with custom exercises and a written guide.

faq: Is the workshop online or in person?
Online by video call, which keeps the price low and lets remote staff join. In person sessions are not part of these fixed price packages.
What does my team need to bring?
A laptop, a work task they would like help with and access to a free or company approved AI tool. We tell you which tools suit the session before the day.
No. We pitch the session at beginners and let confident people go further with the extra exercises. You tell us the starting level when you book.
Do you cover privacy and what not to share?
Yes, in every session. We show what is safe to paste, what is not and how to remove private details first. A full policy is a separate service.
